info.title: Flaglane API
info.description: Feature flags and remote configuration. `/api/**` serves the dashboard with a JWT; `/sdk/**` serves SDKs with an API key.

get.summary: Get a flag's rules in an environment

404.description: No such project, environment or flag among yours

put.summary: Replace a flag's rules in an environment
put.description: The whole ordered list at once, in one transaction, so no partial or reordered state is ever served (FR-RUL-004). A rule the engine could not apply is refused (FR-RUL-010).

400.description: A rule cannot be applied; `errors` names it

404.description: No such project, environment or flag among yours

get.summary: Get a flag's user overrides in an environment

404.description: No such project, environment or flag among yours

put.summary: Replace a flag's user overrides in an environment
put.description: The whole set at once. Overrides apply to server keys only: a client key's ruleset carries none, because their user keys are real user identifiers (FR-KEY-008).

404.description: No such project, environment or flag among yours

post.description: For clients that cannot hold a ruleset. Runs the same engine as the SDK against the same ruleset the key would download, so it answers exactly as in-process evaluation would (FR-SRV-002). An unknown flag, or one this key may not read, is the caller's fallback with reason `FLAG_NOT_FOUND`: never a 404 (FR-EVL-007).

400.description: Malformed body, or a flag without a fallback

503.description: The ruleset is not loaded yet; retry after the time given

post.description: Creates the project with `development`, `staging` and `production` environments (FR-PRJ-001, FR-ENV-001). The key is unique across Flaglane and can never change.

404.description: No such project or flag among yours

post.description: Every environment gets a configuration: disabled, falling through to `false`, at 0% (FR-FLG-003).

409.description: The key is used by a live or an archived flag

404.description: No such project or flag among yours
No such project or flag among yours

post.description: Removes it from every ruleset. Never a deletion: its history stays, its key stays reserved, and it can be restored (FR-FLG-005).

post.description: Creates a dashboard account (FR-ACC-001). The password is stored as a bcrypt hash. Sign in afterwards to obtain a token.

400.description: Malformed email, or a password outside the policy

409.description: An account already uses this email address

Retry-After.description: Seconds until this address may try again

post.description: Issues one access token valid for 8 hours (FR-ACC-002). There is no refresh token, and signing out is discarding the token: nothing invalidates it server-side before it expires (ADR-012).

get.summary: Get a flag's configuration in an environment

404.description: No such project, environment or flag among yours

patch.summary: Change a flag's configuration in an environment
patch.description: Kill switch, fallthrough value, rollout percentage and rollout salt. Takes effect on the environment's next ruleset. **Changing `rolloutSalt` re-buckets every user of this flag.**

404.description: No such project, environment or flag among yours

get.description: Every flag the key may read, for in-process evaluation (FR-SRV-001). A client key gets client-side-visible flags only, with no overrides (FR-KEY-005, FR-KEY-008). The ETag is the ruleset version and the key type; send it as `If-None-Match` for a 304 while nothing has changed. Sent gzipped to a client that accepts gzip, with the same ETag either way.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: An ETag from an earlier response

503.description: The ruleset is not loaded yet; retry after the time given

get.summary: List every flag's configuration in an environment
get.description: One configuration per flag, archived flags included, ordered by flag key. Saves a client listing flags with their state one request per flag.

404.description: No such project or environment among yours

get.description: Newest first, a page at a time. Pagination is keyset on (created_at, id), not offset: pass a page's `next` as `before` for the page after it, and an entry recorded meanwhile neither repeats nor shifts what follows (E-025).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The `next` of the previous page; leave out for the newest entries

400.description: A `before` that is not a cursor, or a `limit` outside 1 to 100

404.description: No such project among yours, or no such environment or flag in it

delete.description: Deletes the environment with its keys, configurations, rules and overrides. Its audit entries are kept. Refused while it holds a key that is not revoked (FR-ENV-003).

409.description: The environment holds an API key that is not revoked

404.description: No such project or environment among yours

delete.description: Refused on every SDK request from the moment this returns (FR-KEY-003). Revoking a revoked key is accepted and changes nothing.

404.description: No such project, environment or key among yours

rules.description: In priority order. An empty list removes every rule (ADR-023: at most 100)

matchValues.description: Strings, numbers or booleans. Exactly one for EQUALS, NOT_EQUALS, CONTAINS, STARTS_WITH and ENDS_WITH, the last three strings only; one or more of one type for IN and NOT_IN (ADR-019)

resultValue.description: What the flag evaluates to when the rule matches

overrides.description: An empty list removes every override (ADR-023: at most 1,000). Overrides do not apply to client keys, on either serving path (FR-KEY-008)

context.description: Who to evaluate for. Optional: without it, evaluation is anonymous

flags.description: The flags to evaluate, each with the value the caller has decided is safe

version.description: The ruleset_version the answers were computed from

key.description: Unique in the project, archived flags included; can never change

clientSideVisible.description: Whether client keys may read it. Defaults to false: browser keys are public

archivedAt.description: Set while the flag is archived

type.description: `server` reads every flag; `client` reads client-side-visible flags only, with no user overrides

key.description: The key. Shown once and never again

password.description: At least 15 characters and at most 72 bytes of UTF-8, the most bcrypt reads

enabled.description: The kill switch. Disabled returns false to everyone

fallthroughValue.description: Returned when the flag is enabled and nothing else matched. While true, the rollout has no effect: everyone it does not reach gets true anyway

rolloutPercentage.description: Whole percent of users, stored as basis points (ADR-011)

rolloutSalt.description: Changing the salt re-buckets every user of this flag: who has it at a given percentage changes. Give flags the same salt to roll them out to the same users (ADR-010)

prefix.description: Enough to tell keys apart; not secret

action.description: From the fixed vocabulary in DATABASE.md

environment.description: The environment's key; null when the change was not to one environment. A deleted environment keeps the key it had

environmentDeleted.description: Whether the environment has been deleted since

flag.description: The flag's key; null when the change was not to one flag

previousValue.description: The state before, as recorded; null for a creation. A rollout is recorded as stored, in basis points under rolloutBasisPoints (ADR-030)

newValue.description: The state after, as recorded; null for a deletion

next.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; null when this page is the last

bearer-jwt.description: An access token from `POST /api/auth/login`, valid for 8 hours.

sdk-key.description: An API key issued for one environment. A server key reads every flag; a client key reads client-side-visible flags only, with no user overrides.
